clips.title: The story
paras: Bathran's Haunt is an ancient kaldorei ruin nestled in northwestern Ashenvale, east of the Zoram Strand. Recently, Forsaken herbalists and their guardians have overtaken the site to harvest local flora for their alchemical research, steadily withering the surrounding woodland.

North of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran, crumbling night elf pillars stand swallowed by thick Ashenvale foliage. What was once a tranquil kaldorei relic has fallen under the shadow of the Forsaken. Skulking among the broken marble, undead herbalists and their enforcers have set up a crude open-air laboratory. Their presence alone blights the ancient soil: grass rots into a sickly brown, vibrant blossoms wilt, and an unnatural decay creeps through the grove as they methodically harvest rare woodland reagents for their experiments.
